scope: research-only focused falsification of the public linear canonical-quotient branch on the actual Hair--Sahai weighted-table source space

primary_sources.title: Witness Encryption via Prime-Order Generic Groups
facts_used: the stacked assignment matrix A(b) uses a shared right factor v(b)
the listed weight family includes the constant polynomial h=1
every satisfying A(b) lies in the public source space S_x
an ordered basis of S_x is deterministically computable in polynomial time

proved: on every satisfiable Hair--Sahai source space, the public h=1 top-left anchor has nonzero restriction and its kernel has codimension one
a normalized source-space representative U_x with anchor one is computable from the public source basis without a witness
every honest satisfying assignment encoding lies in the same public coset U_x + (S_x intersect ker anchor)
every public linear invariant that annihilates that anchor-zero source kernel is witness-free computable
not_proved: impossibility of nonlinear or secret-mode all-witness canonicalization
QPT hiding for any surviving construction
arbitrary-QPT final-key recovery to ORIGINAL-witness extraction
standard-LWE/SIS realization of the surviving source gate
a complete practical generic-NP PQ witness KEM

quantum_classification.new_attack_model: classical polynomial-time public linear algebra; therefore also valid against a QPT-security target
